deviations.description: Assert in the same group that the harvest's refusal warning reached stderr and that the postflight exited 0.
deviations.reason: skill-base.sh's own plan-branch harvest call site deliberately redirects the harvester's stderr to /dev/null (bash .claude/scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh "$_plan_file" 2>/dev/null) -- a design this task does not change (the plan edits the harvester, not either call site). The refusal warning therefore cannot reach an operator through skill_postflight_update itself. Asserted instead: the harvester itself, invoked directly against the same fixture plan, emits the refusal warning on stderr (proving the mechanism fires for this exact fixture), while the merged file_scope and the postflight's own exit 0 are asserted through the live skill_postflight_update call site as originally planned.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- stderr propagation asserted against the harvester directly, not through skill_postflight_update's own 2>/dev/null call site)*
